# VEYA

> VEYA is a post-quantum execution and proof layer for autonomous AI agents on Robinhood Chain. Agents run in scoped environments with tool allowlists; results are checked by 2-of-3 consensus or AES-256-GCM sealed execution, hashed with BLAKE3-256, signed with ML-DSA-44, and anchored on the Veya.sol contract. Mainnet (default), Testnet.

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, 51 `veya_*` tools): https://mcp.veyanet.tech/mcp
- Mainnet Veya.sol: 0x87dC582eEA544A434a5C1e30Ca3d12c1e548a674 (explorer https://robinhoodchain.blockscout.com)
- Public tools need no key. Scoped tools need a product API key (`veya_dev_…` / `veya_live_…`) from https://app.veyanet.tech (connect wallet → System → API Keys). On-chain writes also use the funded wallet bound to that key.

## Agent skill

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/veyanet/veya-skills/blob/main/SKILL.md): install with `npx skills add veyanet/veya-skills`
- [Tool reference](https://github.com/veyanet/veya-skills/blob/main/references/tools.md): all 51 tools with arguments and returns
- [Setup](https://github.com/veyanet/veya-skills/blob/main/references/setup.md): connect Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and other clients
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/veyanet/veya-skills/blob/main/references/troubleshooting.md): server error messages and fixes
